text: COVID-19 vaccines have caused thousands of sudden deaths in otherwise healthy people.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: The COVID-19 vaccines have caused thousands of sudden deaths in otherwise healthy people
room.note: 10% definitely true, 23% probably true, 34% probably false, 31% definitely false.

truthSource.label: CDC, Selected adverse events after COVID-19 vaccination
truthSource.oneLine: Safety monitoring has not found that the vaccines caused thousands of deaths; unverified reports do not establish causation and confirmed vaccine-caused deaths are rare.
